title: Singular-value gap of nonreversible Markov processes
summary: We consider a generalization of the spectral gap of reversible Markov generators to nonreversible processes, following the recent work arXiv:2310.10876 on nonreversible finite-state Markov chains. Extending Chatterjee's observations, we find that this spectral quantity that we call the \textit{singular-value gap} characterizes the convergence of empirical averages, providing upper and lower bounds for finite-time variance uniformly over $L^2$-functions.
